parameters.operation: SELECT to_stage, COUNT(*) as count FROM funnel_movements WHERE moved_at >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY to_stage
SELECT so.*, pi.title FROM strategic_opportunities so JOIN para_items pi ON so.item_id = pi.id WHERE so.identified_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND so.status = 'active'
SELECT issue_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM coherence_issues WHERE fixed_at >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY issue_type

SELECT ts.color_code, COUNT(*) as count FROM task_scores ts JOIN para_items pi ON ts.item_id = pi.id WHERE ts.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE AND pi.stage IN ('jots', 'tasks', 'projects') GROUP BY ts.color_code
